name: chaturanga-phase1-hardware-simulator
description: CHĀTURANGA Phase 1: Browser-based Hardware Simulator for AI Electronic Chessboard

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const mime={'.html':'text/html','.js':'application/javascript','.css':'text/css','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.json':'application/json'}; http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=path.join('.', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); if(!fs.existsSync(p)){ res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not found'); } res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(p)] || 'text/plain'}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(3000, ()=>console.log('CHĀTURANGA Simulator running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: CHĀTURANGA Team
